queries: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, diff_from_overall_avg, diff_from_kept_avg FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of per-transaction averages, excluding transactions whose anlycount is entirely NULL (their average is NULL). Transactions with no non-null anlycount are therefore not kept.
'How far above' is a simple difference (transaction average minus the reference average), unrounded. Ties at the 10th place are included via RANK().

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of per-transaction averages, excluding transactions whose average is NULL (all anlycount values missing). Kept transactions are those with a per-transaction average strictly above it.
Ties with the 10th row are included via FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES (PostgreSQL 13+ syntax), ordering by the difference from the kept-group average.

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-transaction averages. Transactions whose anlycount is all NULL have a NULL average. AVG ignores them, and they are not kept.
The 'top 10 plus ties' rule is implemented with RANK() <= 10 on the difference from the kept-group average. This is the same ordering as the average itself.
